initScript:
#!/bin/bash
# env-bench init script. HEAVY=0 -> S1 (business layer), HEAVY=1 -> S2 (S1 + heavy deps).
# Runs as root, cwd /home/user. Prints one "BENCH_RESULT {json}" line at the end.
HEAVY=${HEAVY:-0}
GH_PROXY=http://sing-box.oma-infra.svc.cluster.local:7890
PIP_INDEX=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/
set -u
ts() { date +%s%3N; }
T_START=$(ts)
STEPS=""
FAILED=""
NOTES=""
add_step() { STEPS="${STEPS}${STEPS:+,}\"$1\":$2"; }
add_note() { NOTES="${NOTES}${NOTES:+,}\"$1\""; }
( while sleep 15; do echo "TICK $(ts)"; done ) &
TICKER=$!
trap 'pkill -P $TICKER 2>/dev/null; kill $TICKER 2>/dev/null' EXIT

mkdir -p /opt/bench/bin /opt/bench/dl
cd /opt/bench/dl

# fetch NAME URL SHA PROXY(0/1) -> downloads to /opt/bench/dl/NAME.pkg, sha256-checked; one retry on failure.
fetch() {
  local name=$1 url=$2 sha=$3 via=$4 attempt s e rc info
  local proxyarg=()
  [ "$via" = 1 ] && proxyarg=(--proxy "$GH_PROXY")
  for attempt in 1 2; do
    s=$(ts)
    info=$(curl -fsSL "${proxyarg[@]}" --noproxy '' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 -o "/opt/bench/dl/$name.pkg" \
      -w '%{http_code} %{size_download} %{speed_download} %{time_connect} %{time_starttransfer} %{time_total}' "$url" 2>/tmp/bench-curl-$name.err)
    rc=$?
    e=$(ts)
    echo "FETCH $name attempt=$attempt via_proxy=$via rc=$rc ms=$((e-s)) info=[$info] err=[$(head -c 200 /tmp/bench-curl-$name.err)]"
    add_note "fetch:$name:attempt=$attempt:rc=$rc:ms=$((e-s)):info=$info"
    if [ $rc = 0 ]; then
      if echo "$sha  /opt/bench/dl/$name.pkg" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi
      echo "FETCH $name sha256 mismatch"; add_note "fetch:$name:sha-mismatch"
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

install_tar_bin() { # name binarySha
  local name=$1 bsha=$2 member
  member=$(tar -tzf "/opt/bench/dl/$name.pkg" | awk -F/ -v n="$name" '$NF==n' | head -1)
  [ -n "$member" ] || return 1
  tar -xzf "/opt/bench/dl/$name.pkg" -C /opt/bench/dl "$member" || return 1
  install -m 0755 "/opt/bench/dl/$member" "/opt/bench/bin/$name" || return 1
  echo "$bsha  /opt/bench/bin/$name" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
}

step() { # name cmd...
  local name=$1; shift
  local s e rc
  s=$(ts)
  "$@"
  rc=$?
  e=$(ts)
  echo "STEP $name rc=$rc ms=$((e-s))"
  add_step "$name" "{\"ms\":$((e-s)),\"rc\":$rc}"
  [ $rc = 0 ] || FAILED="${FAILED}${FAILED:+ }$name"
  return $rc
}

s_vfs() { fetch vfs-cli https://github.com/welltop-cn/vfs-cli-dist/releases/download/v0.3.18/vfs-cli_v0.3.18_linux_amd64.tar.gz 0f710871ade5e30d91ef170e0d352db90bf28f69ba60cb55ee8cc7b820bebacd 1 && install_tar_bin vfs-cli d80b955dd5771c03e6ebbf7fed9abec545b866578c657351c77bdbf33b20142c; }
s_mediakit() { fetch mediakit-cli https://github.com/volcengine/mediakit-cli/releases/download/v0.2.1/mediakit-cli_0.2.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz 8c25ebd7c9446813dabb27700a9d4357c7d2325e528fe9caab31696aa1326987 1 && install_tar_bin mediakit-cli 2c962efef686307e8e839face4a347634e939b84b2a4df5caf292b035e5f96ca; }
s_ossutil() {
  fetch ossutil https://gosspublic.alicdn.com/ossutil/v2/2.2.0/ossutil-2.2.0-linux-amd64.zip 9e02837d806cfe976ae6c1fc22557d8e0a394ca6d298b45fb9f48a360d3a67f4 0 || return 1
  unzip -o -q /opt/bench/dl/ossutil.pkg ossutil-2.2.0-linux-amd64/ossutil -d /opt/bench/dl || return 1
  install -m 0755 /opt/bench/dl/ossutil-2.2.0-linux-amd64/ossutil /opt/bench/bin/ossutil || return 1
  echo "de09edc5649d00bf9495040b09c70a52174f7ae6b812097411f46def16d47c2f  /opt/bench/bin/ossutil" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
}
s_venv() { /opt/venv/bin/python3 -m venv /opt/bench/venv; }
s_pip() {
  cat > /opt/bench/requirements.txt <<'REQ'
# No local-tokenizer extra: the image does not bundle model inference runtimes.
google-genai==2.22.0
REQ
  /opt/bench/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check --progress-bar off --index-url "$PIP_INDEX" -r /opt/bench/requirements.txt
}
s_pip_heavy() { /opt/bench/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check --progress-bar off --index-url "$PIP_INDEX" 'scenedetect[opencv]' pandas scipy matplotlib scikit-learn; }
s_apt_update() { DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update; }
s_apt_install() { DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libreoffice-core; }
s_verify() {
  /opt/bench/bin/vfs-cli --version && /opt/bench/bin/mediakit-cli --version && /opt/bench/bin/ossutil version && \
  /opt/bench/venv/bin/python3 -c 'import google.genai as g; print("genai", g.__version__)' || return 1
  if [ "$HEAVY" = 1 ]; then
    /opt/bench/venv/bin/python3 -c 'import cv2, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, sklearn, scenedetect; print("heavy", cv2.__version__, pandas.__version__, scipy.__version__, sklearn.__version__, scenedetect.__version__)' || return 1
    test -x /usr/lib/libreoffice/program/soffice.bin || return 1
  fi
}
s_markers() {
  local id
  id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)
  echo "$id" > /opt/bench/build-marker
  echo "$id" > /tmp/bench-build-marker
  echo "$id" > /root/bench-build-marker
  echo "$id" > /var/tmp/bench-build-marker
  su -s /bin/sh user -c "echo $id > /home/user/bench-build-marker"
  rm -rf /opt/bench/dl
}

step vfs_cli s_vfs
step mediakit_cli s_mediakit
step ossutil s_ossutil
step venv s_venv
step pip_requirements s_pip
if [ "$HEAVY" = 1 ]; then
  step pip_heavy s_pip_heavy
  step apt_update s_apt_update
  step apt_install s_apt_install
fi
step verify s_verify
step markers s_markers
T_END=$(ts)
RESULT="{\"heavy\":$HEAVY,\"totalMs\":$((T_END-T_START)),\"failed\":\"$FAILED\",\"steps\":{$STEPS},\"notes\":[$NOTES]}"
echo "$RESULT" > /opt/bench/build-result.json
echo "BENCH_RESULT $RESULT"
[ -z "$FAILED" ]
